evidence_requirement: two mechanically independent signals per load-bearing claim (rules/common/single-signal-verification.md); every claim carries source lineage (resolved URL + fetch timestamp + sha256 of the fetched bytes), a Sherman-Kent confidence band, and a named independent verification path (_USER-PROMPTS.md:10717); the back-test names each prior adoption, its metric (or the absence of one) and the verdict; adoptions with no metric are counted as WOULD-NOT-HAVE-PASSED, which is the honest reading
inputs: _USER-PROMPTS.md:10681-10717 (Phase 2 source classes, 12 research modes, claim requirements)
question_or_target: Specify the adopt/park/reject decision record that binds every adopted mechanism to a named before/after metric, a revert trigger and an owner-visible cost line - and back-test it against the mechanisms this estate adopted in the last two sweeps: how many would have survived their own gate?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: after 2 failures on the same error fingerprint, enumerate >=2 alternative approaches before a third attempt (AGENTS.md 4b)
reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial refuter in a fresh context who defaults to REFUTED when evidence is insufficient (spec:11062)
tests_required: negative control: the back-test must produce at least one WOULD-NOT-HAVE-PASSED verdict on a mechanism still in use; a gate that retroactively blesses everything already adopted is not a gate
title: Adoption gate: a gem may be kept only when improvement is measured, and reverted otherwise
